content:
The v4.18.0 release of Lean is here!

There are many bugfixes, performance gains, and improvements to the Lean language. Please read the release notes for details. (Note that going forward all release notes are available as part of the Lean Language Reference.)

Batteries, Aesop, ProofWidgets, and Mathlib are all now available for v4.18.0.

  • there is a v4.18.0 tag in each repository if you would like to pin to a commit using this toolchain.
